lines.label: Change
lines.note: Passive - Doom: Periodically, Vex gains Doom, which empowers her next basic ability to knockdown affected enemies and cause them to flee from her for 0.75–1.5 seconds, during which they are slow by 60–99% (250–800).

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Doom's cooldown resets upon respawning. If Looming Darkness}} triggers Doom, all targets will flee from the center of its area of effect instead.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Innate - Gloom: Nearby enemy champions that dash or blink, as well as targets hit by Looming Darkness}}, will be marked with Gloom for 6 seconds. Vex's next basic attack, which becomes projectile, Mistral Bolt}}, or Personal Space}} against a marked target will consume the mark to deal 30–180 (+ 25% AP) and refund 25% of Doom's cooldown.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Against marked non-champions, Gloom deals 40–60% damage and refunds 10% of Doom's cooldown.
